summary: Iteration 6: AquaX Planejamento features testing completed. All 10 backend tests passed. All 11 frontend features verified via Playwright. The 3 key changes are working correctly: 1) Prazo field visible in header, 2) AquaX products show 'Nº Aplicações' instead of 'Estágio' with Volume = Dose × Nº aplicações, 3) Label changed to 'Valor (R$/L)'.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 5638 lines - consider splitting into smaller components for maintainability
AQUAX_TECH_ID constant correctly defined at line 2532
isAquaxProduct function correctly checks technology_id at line 2533
Conditional rendering for Nº Aplicações vs Estágio working correctly (lines 3972-4008)
Volume calculation logic correct: AquaX = dose × numAplicacoes, Other = dose × area (lines 4143-4177)
PDF generation includes Prazo field (lines 4494-4497) and shows 'Nº aplicações' for AquaX products (line 4507)
seed_data_creation: N/A - used existing AquaX products (CitroX, TEK-F, Alvo, DTA) and non-AquaX product (Active)
context_for_next_testing_agent: AquaX Planejamento features fully tested. Key findings: 1) Prazo field (data-testid='prazo-input') visible in Planejamento form header. 2) AquaX products (technology_id='c1e0d560-297f-4879-9c1f-e732342558aa') show 'Nº Aplicações' input (data-testid='num-aplicacoes-{index}') instead of 'Estágio' dropdown. 3) Non-AquaX products show 'Estágio' dropdown (data-testid='estagio-select-{index}'). 4) Volume calculation: AquaX = Dose × Nº aplicações, Non-AquaX = Dose × Área. 5) Label 'Valor (R$/L)' is correct format. 6) PDF generation includes Prazo and shows 'Nº aplicações' for AquaX products. Product selection uses dropdown 'Selecione um produto...' not tabs.
